### New Mercies Every Morning
Author: Dave Zuleger
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/new-mercies-every-morning
Passage: Lamentations 3:22-24
Points:
- Morning anxiety often stems from self-reliance rather than resting in God's sovereign ability.
- In Christ, the Lord's steadfast love and compassions never fail and are renewed daily.
- God provides sufficient mercy for today's burdens rather than storing up strength for tomorrow.
- Walking closely with Jesus requires seeking Him afresh each day through prayer and Scripture.
- Peace comes not from managing endless to-do lists, but from committing our cares to God.

### Hope Amid the Ruins
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/hope-amid-ruins
Passage: Lamentations 3:22-33
Points:
- The survival of a remnant amidst Jerusalem's destruction testified to God's enduring covenant mercy.
- Faith looks past bleak ruins to realize God did not inflict the total destruction His people deserved.
- The Lord does not inflict grief willingly or take pleasure in the suffering of His people.
- While divine wrath is a necessary holy response to sin, His redeeming love is an unmerited gift.
- Believers can trust that God's steadfast love remains secure even when they stumble.

### Remembering That God Is Faithful
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/remembering-that-god-is-faithful
Passage: Lamentations 3:19-23
Points:
- Recalling the Lord's character turns the soul from bitter afflictions toward enduring hope.
- God's compassions never run out and are supplied anew with each sunrise.
- The Lord remains true to His word and will not abandon or cast out those who come to Him.
- Divine goodness and faithfulness actively pursue believers to draw wayward hearts back home.

### 4 Steps to Prepare Your Heart for the Demands of a New Day
Author: Dana Che
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/4-steps-to-prepare-your-heart-for-the-demands-of-a-new-day.html
Passage: Lamentations 3:22-24
Points:
- Meditating on God's morning mercies anchors the heart against daily overwhelm and stress.
- Opening the morning with praise acknowledges God's constant faithfulness in every circumstance.
- Praying before entering the daily routine invites God's wisdom and guidance into each decision.
- Aligning our spiritual posture gives us confidence rooted in God to handle life's pressures.
- Organizing and prioritizing daily tasks in faith allows us to walk in God's peace.
